description: Convert PNG images to smaller JPG files with adjustable quality and a custom background color for transparent areas. Batch convert and download as a ZIP.

faqs.a: JPG does not support transparency, so any transparent pixels are filled with the background color you pick (white by default).
Around 85 looks great for photos. Below 70 you may see blocky artifacts; 95 is near-lossless but much larger.
No — everything runs locally in your browser via the canvas API. No uploads, no watermarks, no limits.

howto: Drop one or more PNG files into the upload zone.
Pick a background color for transparent areas and set the JPEG quality (10–100).
Click “Convert to JPG” and review the per-file size savings.
Download each JPG individually or all together as a ZIP.
title: PNG to JPG Converter
